fixture: stale-1.1.0 (paired against conforming-1.1.0, which does not carry it)
note: Every stamp predates the build by years and the newest changelog entry describes the PREVIOUS release. Stamp drift catches metadata generated at the wrong time; version silence catches metadata generated at the right time about the wrong release, which no timestamp can see.

must_report_on.evidence_note: Evidence is keyed PER CHECK. A finding satisfies this golden only if it names the check AND points at one of that check's own locations - pooling evidence across a case let any check pass on another's, which a shotgun exploited. Where a check's declared violation_unit is the document itself, the document-only form is accepted, per lint-report-v1's evidence description.

must_not_report_on.note: The control ships the same source and conforming metadata. A linter that reports here is reporting on the package, not on the defect.

why_this_case_was_missing: 042 is new in 0.6.0 and had no artifact. The stale arm is also the only fixture whose stamps are committed rather than written at build time - being outside the window is the thing it demonstrates.
